# Microtech India — Contract Micronization & Milling Services

> Microtech India is a leading FDA-inspected and cGMP-compliant Contract Manufacturing Organization (CMO) providing specialized contract micronization, mechanical milling, sieving, and particle size analysis services for active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and excipients.

## Primary Capabilities
- **Contract Micronization**: Fluid Energy Air Jet Milling for ultra-fine particle size reduction (down to sub-micron / 1-10 microns) without thermal degradation.
- **Mechanical Milling**: High-capacity grinding, pin-milling, and multi-milling for controlled particle size distributions.
- **Sieving & Classification**: Precision screening and top-size control for uniform bulk material handling.
- **Particle Size Analysis**: Advanced laser diffraction characterization using Malvern Mastersizer 2000 & 3000 instruments.
- **Scale**: R&D scale trials (from 10 grams) up to commercial bulk production (200 Metric Ton monthly capacity).

## Compliance & Certifications
- **FDA Inspected**: Approved for processing pharmaceutical APIs destined for global regulated markets.
- **cGMP Standards**: Strict cleanroom environments, cleaning validations, and complete batch traceability.
- **ISO 9001:2015 Certified**: Quality management system covering all operations.

## Manufacturing Locations
- **Head Office & Main Plant**: Plot No. 5046, G.I.D.C., Ankleshwar — 393 002, Gujarat, India.
- **Unit 1 Plant**: Plot No. 205-206-207/20, GIDC Estate, Panoli — 394 115, Gujarat, India.
